Supreme Court Collegium Recommends Three High Court Chief Justices for Elevation

The Supreme Court Collegium has recommended three High Court Chief Justices for elevation to the Supreme Court. The Chief Justices of Gujarat, Delhi, and Telangana High Courts are among those recommended for appointment as apex court judges.
